query: If an Indian citizen commits an offence outside India, can BNS apply?

gold_references.label: Section 1(5)(a)
gold_references.role: BNS applies to any citizen of India in any place outside India

required_points: Yes. Section 1(5)(a) provides that the provisions of BNS shall apply to any citizen of India in any place outside India.
The illustration in Section 1 gives the example that A, a citizen of India who commits murder in any place outside India, can be tried and convicted in India.
forbidden_points: BNS applies outside India only to government employees.

notes: Multi-hop query. Section 1(5)(a) is the applicable provision.
